text: The paper reports that Human+CriticGPT teams write substantially more comprehensive critiques than humans alone, and that CriticGPT is more comprehensive than ChatGPT on both detected and inserted bugs. Models nitpick and hallucinate bugs much more often than humans, CriticGPT substantially less than ChatGPT, and human-machine teams fall in between.
title: Human+CriticGPT teams: more comprehensive than humans, fewer hallucinations than models
